content: The story behind The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth isn't quite as dramatic, but the ultimate effect is similar. Nobody died. Quentin Tarantino just made the bizarre decision that his 10th film should be his last and that a sequel to Once Upon a Time in Hollywood wasn't going to cut it. So instead of trashing the film like he did with his last failed effort, Tarantino handed the script off to David Fincher. The result is another unusual melding of directorial styles that doesn't always work (it's definitely not the best either Fincher or Tarantino has to offer), but still manages to provide a uniquely fun time at the movies — and also on Netflix later this year.
